title: SLATE: Slope Landslide Analytics and Triggering Explorer
description: SLATE is an interactive research platform for landslide susceptibility and rainfall-triggering analysis in India. It runs the study's models in the browser (rainfall events, thresholds, SACT, TRIGRS factor of safety, ML nowcasts, two-tier research priority) from the archived IMD 0.25 degree daily rainfall 1991-2025. Research model output. Not an official landslide warning.
